cases.situation: Landlord Ray emailed that my rent goes from $1,650 to $1,950 at renewal in December. Similar 1-beds on my block are $1,700 to $1,800. I've been here 4 years and never paid late.
cases.reply:
Hi Ray,
Thanks for the heads-up about the increase to $1,950. I'd like to ask you to reconsider. Comparable one-bedrooms on this block are listed at $1,700 to $1,800, and I've paid on time for four years. I'd be glad to sign another 12 months at $1,750. Would that work? Happy to talk by phone.
Best,
Nina
cases.note: Counter with a number and facts, not a flat no. If he holds firm, meet halfway and attach a repair to it.

cases.situation: Bin Ende August ausgezogen. Mein Vermieter Herr Vogt will 350 € fürs Streichen von der Kaution (1.200 €) abziehen, obwohl die Wände laut Übergabeprotokoll in Ordnung waren. Die 60 € für die Reinigung sind okay.
cases.reply:
Sehr geehrter Herr Vogt,
vielen Dank für die Abrechnung. Den Abzug von 350 € für das Streichen kann ich nicht akzeptieren: Im Übergabeprotokoll vom 31. August sind die Wände als einwandfrei vermerkt, die Fotos hänge ich an. Die 60 € für die Reinigung akzeptiere ich. Bitte überweisen Sie mir die verbleibenden 1.140 € bis zum 16. Oktober. Ich würde das gern direkt mit Ihnen klären, rufen Sie mich gern an.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Lena Hoffmann
cases.note: Den berechtigten Posten anzuerkennen macht den Widerspruch beim Rest glaubwürdiger.

cases.situation: 装修师傅报价说好全屋刷墙8000，现在结账要10500，说是多加了一遍腻子。之前完全没跟我提过要加钱。
cases.reply: 李师傅，这段时间辛苦了。当时说好的全屋刷墙是8000，这次的单子是10500，多出来的2500能跟我说说具体是哪几项吗？加腻子的事之前没跟我确认过。说好的8000我今天就先转给您，剩下的咱们对一下再说。
cases.note: 先付没有争议的部分，只对差额提问，不指责对方故意多收。

cases.situation: Our heating has been broken since Sept 14. I texted our landlord Donna that day and again on the 21st, she said 'I'll get someone out' and nothing happened. Nights are getting cold and we have two little kids.
cases.reply:
Hi Donna,
This is a formal repair request for the heating, first reported to you by text on 14 September and again on the 21st. It still isn't working, and with two young children at home and nights getting colder, it can't wait much longer. Please confirm a repair date by Monday 5 October. I'd still prefer to sort this informally, so do call me on 07700 900 482.
Thanks,
Owen
cases.note: Third step on the ladder: dates of the earlier requests and one dated ask. Not a threat yet. Cite the lease only if it actually says who repairs heating; otherwise check local rules or a tenant advice service.

cases.situation: I'm a landlord. My tenant Omar has been great for 3 years. He paid only $700 of his $1,400 September rent and texted that he lost shifts at the warehouse. October rent is due Thursday.
cases.reply: Hi Omar, thanks for telling me straight away, and I'm sorry about the shifts. The $700 balance for September is still outstanding, and October's $1,400 is due Thursday 1 October. Could we agree a plan in writing by Friday? One option: the $700 split into two payments of $350, added to your October and November rent. If something else works better for you, tell me and we'll work it out.
cases.note: Landlord side: exact amounts and dates, one concrete plan offered, and room for his version.

cases.situation: 房东突然说要卖房，让我10月底前搬走。合同签到明年2月底，里面写了房东提前解约要提前一个月通知并赔一个月租金（4,500元）。我可以搬，但时间太紧，想争取一下。
cases.reply: 王姐您好，卖房的事收到了，我理解，也愿意配合。10月底前找房加搬家时间比较紧，我想11月15号前搬完。按合同约定，房东提前解约需赔付一个月租金4,500元，麻烦您在我交钥匙当天把押金和这4,500元一起退给我。这段时间带人看房我都配合，提前一天说一声就行。您看这样可以吗？周五前回我一下，我好开始安排。
cases.note: 合同只引用一次、语气平和，把要求落到具体日期和金额；配合看房是让对方好答应的筹码。

cases.situation: Hired a kitchen fitter, Wes, for £9,200. I've paid £6,000 so far and the last £3,200 is due on completion. He was meant to finish on 18 September. The worktops and sink still aren't in and his texts have been vague for a week.
cases.reply: Hi Wes, the kitchen was due to be finished on Friday 18 September, and the worktops and sink still aren't in, and I haven't had a clear answer on timing for a week. Could you give me a completion date by Thursday 1 October? I'll pay the final £3,200 as soon as the job's done, as agreed.
cases.note: Facts, the agreed payment as the lever, one dated ask. If Thursday passes, move one step up to a formal written deadline, not a threat.

cases.situation: 9月20号退租搬走，钥匙当面交给房东张阿姨，她当时看了房子说没问题。合同写押金6000元退房后7天内退，到今天还没退，之前发过一条消息她也没回。
cases.reply: 张阿姨您好，我9月20号退的房，钥匙当面交给您，您当时也看过房子，说没问题。合同里写押金6000元在退房后7天内退还，麻烦您在10月9日（周五）前退到我之前交房租用的那张银行卡上。这两年住得很舒心，谢谢您的照顾。
cases.note: 第一次正式提：事实、合同写的期限、一个带日期的具体请求，语气客气。到期还没退，再往上走一步，写明会去哪里投诉。

cases.situation: Roofer Carlos quoted $6,800 to replace the flat roof on our garage. Another roofer quoted $5,200 for the same job, but Carlos was much more thorough and explained the flashing issues. I'd rather hire him if he can come down.
cases.reply: Hi Carlos, thanks for the detailed quote and for explaining the flashing issues. At $6,800 it's above what I can do; I have another quote at $5,200 for the same scope. I'd rather go with you, given how carefully you went through the flashing. Could you get it to $5,800, perhaps by reusing the existing gutters? If so, I can confirm today for the week of 12 October.
cases.note: Quote too high: name the competing number once, say why you prefer them, and ask for a specific figure with a way to reach it.

cases.situation: Mould in our bedroom since late August. I emailed my landlord, Gary, on Sept 3 and again on Sept 17 with photos. Today he replied: 'Stop harassing me. It's condensation, open a window, I'll look at it when I have time.'
cases.reply:
Hi Gary,
I'll leave the tone to one side. The mould in the bedroom has been there since late August. I reported it by email on 3 September and again on 17 September, with photos, and it is still there. Whatever the cause, I'd like it looked at properly. Please confirm a date for someone to inspect it by Friday 2 October. If I haven't heard by then, I'll ask the local council's housing team to inspect, which I'd rather avoid.
Thanks,
Priya
cases.note: A hostile reply gets only the facts, one step up the ladder, and a next step you would actually take. Check your tenancy agreement and local rules on who is responsible for damp before citing either.

cases.situation: 我租的房子，房东周叔这个月两次趁我上班时自己开门进来，说是看看热水器，事先都没说。合同第六条写了进屋需提前24小时通知。我不想闹翻，但这样不行。
cases.reply: 周叔您好，9月12日和9月26日您在我上班时进过屋，我事先都不知道。您关心热水器我很感谢，但屋里有我的私人物品，没人在时有人进来我会很不安。合同第六条约定进屋要提前24小时通知，以后麻烦您先发微信约个时间，我工作日晚上7点后和周末都在。热水器如果需要检修，这周六上午10点您方便吗？
cases.note: 事实加日期，合同只引用一次，给一个具体的替代做法和时间，不指责、不威胁。

cases.situation: 房东刘姐说续租房租要从5200涨到5800。我回复说附近同户型挂5300到5500，我住了三年从没拖欠过，希望续一年5400。她回：“5800已经很便宜了，不行就算了。”我还是想留下。
cases.reply: 刘姐，理解您的考虑。那我们各让一步，5600续签一年，您看行吗？另外阳台那扇关不严的推拉门，如果能在新合同开始前修好，我这周就可以签。
cases.note: 对方态度变硬时不争谁对：给一个折中数字，附一个具体的修缮请求，并说明你马上可以签。

cases.situation: Swift Movers moved us on Sept 25. They cracked the glass top of our dining table and dented the fridge door; the crew lead, Marco, noted both on the delivery sheet before I signed. New glass is quoted at $420, and the contract says damage claims must be in writing within 30 days.
cases.reply:
Hi,
I'm filing a damage claim for our move on 25 September, job 48213. During the move the glass top of our dining table was cracked and the fridge door was dented; your crew lead, Marco, noted both on the delivery sheet before I signed. Photos, the signed sheet and a $420 quote for replacement glass are attached, and I'll send a repair estimate for the fridge door next week. I'm filing within the 30 days set out in our contract. Could you confirm receipt and your next steps by Friday 9 October? I'd much rather settle this directly with you.
Thanks,
Elena Park
cases.note: A service-provider claim: dated facts, their own paperwork as evidence, the contract cited once. Check whether the contract caps payouts before accepting an offer.

cases.situation: A pipe off our boiler burst around 11pm on Saturday Sept 26 and water came through the kitchen ceiling. I called my landlord Peter three times and texted, no answer until Monday, so I got an emergency plumber out myself for £285. I want him to pay it back.
cases.reply:
Hi Peter,
Confirming what happened on Saturday 26 September: a pipe off the boiler burst at about 11pm and water was coming through the kitchen ceiling. I called you three times and texted at 11:10pm, and when I couldn't reach you I called an emergency plumber, who capped the pipe that night. His £285 invoice and photos of the leak are attached. Could you reimburse the £285 by Friday 9 October, by bank transfer, or confirm in writing that I can take it off November's rent? The permanent repair still needs booking, and I'm home after 5pm any weekday.
Thanks,
Amara
cases.note: Keep the call log and the invoice. Check what the lease says about emergency repairs, and never deduct from rent without his written okay.

cases.situation: I'm a landlord. My tenant Leah moved out on Sept 27 after two years; the deposit is $1,500. The place is spotless except a palm-sized burn mark on the bedroom carpet that isn't in the move-in inventory. Replacing that room's carpet is quoted at $380.
cases.reply: Hi Leah, thanks for leaving the apartment in such good shape; the kitchen and bathroom were spotless. The one issue from the check-out is a palm-sized burn mark on the bedroom carpet, which isn't in the move-in inventory; photos from both are attached, along with a $380 quote to replace that room's carpet. I'm proposing to deduct $380 and return $1,120 to you by Friday 9 October. If you see it differently, let me know by Monday 5 October and we can talk it through.
cases.note: Landlord side of a deposit: evidence, one itemised amount, a date. Check your lease and local rules on deadlines and whether the carpet's age limits what you can charge.

cases.situation: Se soltó la manguera de mi lavadora y se mojó el parqué del salón junto a la cocina: unas seis tablas levantadas. Mi casera, Carmen, quiere cambiar todo el suelo del salón y que yo pague 2.400 €. Un parquetista me ha presupuestado 450 € por cambiar solo esas tablas por el mismo modelo.
cases.reply: Hola, Carmen. Siento lo del parqué: la manguera era de mi lavadora y me hago cargo de la reparación. El daño afecta a unas seis tablas junto a la cocina, y un parquetista me ha presupuestado 450 € por cambiarlas por el mismo modelo; te adjunto el presupuesto. No veo motivo para cambiar todo el suelo del salón, pero si quieres que antes lo revise un profesional de tu confianza, dime qué día te viene bien y lo organizamos. ¿Te parece bien que avancemos así?
cases.note: Cuando el daño es tuyo: asúmelo sin rodeos y discute solo el alcance, con un presupuesto. Revisa si tu seguro de hogar cubre daños por agua.

cases.situation: 找了个装修队翻新卫生间，总价3万，工头陈师傅要求开工前先付70%，也就是2.1万，说下周一就能开工。方案我挺满意，愿意付定金，但想按进度分三次付：开工付30%，水电验收后付40%，完工验收后付30%。
cases.reply: 陈师傅，方案和报价我都挺满意，想尽快定下来。付款方式想跟您商量一下：开工当天付30%，9000元；水电验收后付40%，12000元；完工验收后付尾款30%，9000元。这样材料款您有着落，我这边也踏实。您看可以的话，我们把这几个节点写进合同，下周一照常开工。
cases.note: 付款节点跟验收挂钩并写进合同；先说清你想用他，分期才像商量而不是不信任。

cases.situation: 租的房子用燃气热水器，装在卫生间里。最近洗澡时一氧化碳报警器响了两次，9月27日和29日，27日当天我就微信告诉了房东赵哥，他回“老房子都这样，开窗就行”。我现在不敢用热水器了，晚上7点后和周末都在家。
cases.reply: 赵哥，热水器的事想再正式跟您说一下：卫生间的一氧化碳报警器9月27日和29日洗澡时响了两次，27日当天我就微信告诉过您。报警器响可能是漏气或排烟不畅，开窗解决不了根本问题，所以检查之前我先不用热水器了。麻烦您10月2日（周五）前安排有资质的师傅上门检查，我晚上7点后和周末都在家。谢谢您。
cases.note: 报警器再响就立刻关气、开窗、离开屋子，到室外打燃气抢修电话或119。

cases.situation: I'm a landlord. The boiler in my flat on Fenwick Road needs replacing and the engineer can do Tuesday 6 October or Thursday 8 October, 8am to 1pm, with no heating or hot water during the job. My tenant Aisha works night shifts and sleeps until about 2pm; the tenancy agreement says I give at least 24 hours' written notice for access, and I'll be there myself to let the engineer in.
cases.reply: Hi Aisha, the boiler is due to be replaced, and the engineer can come on Tuesday 6 October or Thursday 8 October, 8am to 1pm. There'll be no heating or hot water while they work. I know you sleep during the day after night shifts, so which of the two days would disrupt you less? I'll be there to let the engineer in myself, so you won't need to get up, and I'll confirm the day in writing once you choose.
cases.note: Landlord side: offer a choice that fits the tenant's life; the notice clause is the minimum, not the whole courtesy.

cases.situation: I've rented flat 3 at 22 Grove Lane from Mrs Patel for two years and always paid on time. Clause 14 of the lease says no pets without the landlord's written consent. I want to adopt Pepper, a 4-year-old neutered indoor cat, from a shelter on Saturday 17 October, and I'm happy to add £200 to the deposit and pay for a professional carpet clean when I move out.
cases.reply: Hi Mrs Patel, I'd like to ask for your written consent under clause 14 of the lease to keep a cat at flat 3. She's Pepper, a 4-year-old neutered indoor cat from a shelter, and I'm hoping to bring her home on Saturday 17 October. I'm happy to add £200 to the deposit and to pay for a professional carpet clean when I move out. Could you let me know by Friday 9 October whether that works for you? Thank you, and thanks for two good years here.
cases.note: A permission request: cite the clause, take the risk off her plate up front, and set a reply date that leaves time before the adoption.

cases.situation: 302号室の山本です。管理会社の田中さんから、外壁工事で10月5日から11月末まで足場が組まれ、ベランダが使えないと連絡がありました。平日9時から17時は在宅勤務で騒音も心配です。家賃は月8万2千円で、工事期間中だけ1割下げてもらえないか相談したいです。
cases.reply: 田中様、いつもお世話になっております。302号室の山本です。外壁工事のご連絡ありがとうございます。10月5日から11月末までベランダが使えず、平日日中は在宅勤務のため騒音の影響も大きいので、工事期間中の家賃（月8万2千円）を1割減額していただけないか、ご相談させてください。工事が必要なことは理解しておりますので、協力いたします。10月9日（金）までにご検討いただけますと幸いです。
cases.note: 減額に応じる義務があるかは契約書と地域のルールで違うので確認を。頼む金額は一つに絞る。

cases.situation: 我租的是阳光花园3栋502，房东李姐。合同第五条写水电费按表计实际费用缴纳，但她这半年一直按每度1.2元收电费；我查了电费单，实际是每度0.62元，算下来多交了大约600元。想跟她说清楚，不想闹僵。
cases.reply: 李姐您好，我是阳光花园3栋502的租客。我核对了电费单，实际电价是每度0.62元，这半年咱们一直按每度1.2元结算，算下来我多交了大约600元。合同第五条写的是水电费按表计实际费用缴纳，所以想跟您商量：从下个月起按实际电价结，之前多交的部分在10月房租里抵扣，您看可以吗？电费单截图我一起发给您。
cases.note: 只摆单据和合同条款，不猜动机；如果她说有公摊等其他费用，请她列出明细再核对。

cases.situation: I'm Mia. My landlord, Steve, wants me to pay $520 for a new washing machine because the one in the flat stopped spinning last week. It was there when I moved in four years ago, the repair technician's note says the motor wore out with age, and my lease says appliances supplied with the flat are the landlord's to maintain.
cases.reply:
Hi Steve,
Thanks for letting me know about the replacement. I don't think the $520 should be mine, though: the machine came with the flat when I moved in four years ago, and the technician's note, attached, says the motor wore out with age. Under the lease, appliances supplied with the flat are the landlord's to maintain. Could you confirm by Friday 9 October that the cost sits with you? Happy to talk it through by phone.
Thanks,
Mia
cases.note: Wear and tear versus a charge: the technician's note and the lease clause, once, then a dated ask. Check the exact wording of your lease before citing it.

cases.situation: 我是房东，租客小王在我家的两居室住了四年，房租一直是每月3800元，从没涨过，也从不拖欠。合同12月31日到期，约定续租前一个月商量。周边同户型现在挂4500左右，我想从2027年1月1日起涨到4100。
cases.reply: 小王你好，合同12月31日到期，想提前跟你商量续租的事。这四年房租一直是3800没动过，现在周边同户型大概挂4500，所以想从2027年1月1日起调到每月4100。你四年来从没拖欠过，我很希望你继续住。你看看能不能接受，有想法直接跟我说，10月20日前回我就行。
cases.note: 房东涨租：具体数字、生效日期和一句理由，表明想留住对方并留出商量空间；涨幅和通知期先核对合同和当地规定。
